title: Paint Commons range file
description: One file per brand and range: paints/<brand>/<range>.json, an array of paints sorted by code then name.

id.description: Stable id. Leave it out for a new paint; it's filled in after the paint is imported.

range.description: Product line as the manufacturer names it.

code.description: Manufacturer product code, e.g. WP3001 or 72.051. Null when none is known.

name.description: Name as printed by the manufacturer.

colour.description: Approximate colour of the paint in the pot. Leave out when there's no published source.

gradient.description: Only colours a source showed. Metallics and colour-shift paints: two or more stops sampled across the swatch (apps draw them dark to light and add a very light end when the source has none). Speedpaints, washes and glazes: one to three stops in the order pooled, true colour, thinned; the true colour equals hex, a position the source doesn't show is null, and apps generate missing stops (speedpaints drawn as bands, washes and glazes as a smooth blend).

source.description: An id from sources.json colour_sources with status published.

status.description: Paints are never removed; mark them discontinued.

source.description: Where this paint's details (name, code, range) came from, when imported from another project: an id from sources.json with status published. Records citing a source keep that source's licence and credit.

finish.description: Documented paint finish. Omit or use null when unknown; do not infer from the digital swatch.

manufacturer_colour_family.description: Manufacturer-published colour family or triad name; distinct from calculated display families.
